verdict.rationale: Belvo documents registrable outbound webhooks: you supply a URL and an optional authorization token (belvo-docs-25). Recurrent links refresh weekly and notify you via webhook (belvo-docs-26), async workflows cut out follow-up POST calls (belvo-docs-10, belvo-docs-11), and Smart Collections notifies you when balance conditions are met (belvo-docs-4). However, the only protection evidenced is a bearer-style auth token, not signed payloads, and the event coverage is not enumerated. missing for 10: cryptographic payload signing (HMAC/signature verification), explicit transaction-level and connection-state-change event types, near-real-time rather than weekly refresh cadence, independent corroboration.
